en: \bHow have you been since becoming Monarch? I was on the edge of my seat like a pot about to boil over.
it: \bCome te la passi da quando sei diventato Monarca? Ero sulle spine come una pentola sul punto di traboccare.

id: \bI actually watched it with a friend of mine who recently went into the forest. I was just preparing to go after him. Perhaps you could help me with that.
en: \bI actually watched it with a friend of mine who recently went into the forest. I was just preparing to go after him. Perhaps you could help me with that.

en: \bCilan: Ah, what a delectable battle that was. Your aroma has only been enhanced by your experiences.

id: Ballonlea Pokémon Gym Leader:\nOpal
en: Ballonlea Pokémon Gym Leader:\nOpal
it: Capopalestra della Palestra Pokémon di Ballonlea:\nOpal

id: The master of a fantastic theater!
en: The master of a fantastic theater!
it: La maestra di un teatro fantastico!

id: \rOpal: You lack pink.
en: \rOpal: You lack pink.
it: \rOpal: Ti manca il rosa.

id: \rHere's a quiz. Pink. Purple.
en: \rHere's a quiz. Pink. Purple.
it: \rEcco un quiz. Rosa. Viola.

id: \rIncorrect. Pink is what I like to see in other people, not myself.
en: \rIncorrect. Pink is what I like to see in other people, not myself.
it: \rSbagliato. Il rosa è ciò che mi piace vedere negli altri, non in me stessa.

id: \rI see you have good taste. Next question.
en: \rI see you have good taste. Next question.
it: \rVedo che hai buon gusto. Prossima domanda.

id: \rHow old am I?
en: \rHow old am I?
it: \rQuanti anni ho?

id: \rHow kind. Obviously wrong, but I appriciate the thought. Next question.
en: \rHow kind. Obviously wrong, but I appriciate the thought. Next question.
it: \rChe gentile. Ovviamente sbagliato, ma apprezzo il pensiero. Prossima domanda.

id: \rYou're not wrong. But you could have been a little more sensitive.
en: \rYou're not wrong. But you could have been a little more sensitive.
it: \rNon hai torto. Ma potevi essere un po' più delicato.

id: \rFinal question. What is this Pokémon next to me?
en: \rFinal question. What is this Pokémon next to me?
it: \rUltima domanda. Che Pokémon è questo accanto a me?

id: \rInsightful. You have pink in your heart after all.
en: \rInsightful. You have pink in your heart after all.
it: \rPerspicace. Dopotutto hai del rosa nel cuore.

id: \rI'm afraid not. You lack pink in your heart.
en: \rI'm afraid not. You lack pink in your heart.
it: \rTemo di no. Ti manca il rosa nel cuore.

id: \rOpal: This Pokémon is one of many you can find in Glimwood Tangle. Treat the forest kind, and it will reward you in return.
en: \rOpal: This Pokémon is one of many you can find in Glimwood Tangle. Treat the forest kind, and it will reward you in return.
it: \rOpal: Questo Pokémon è uno dei tanti che puoi trovare nel Bosco Lucente. Tratta bene la foresta e lei ti ricompenserà.

id: \bGoh: Finally, an end to the questions. I was starting to think they'd never end. I'll send data over to the Professor.
en: \bGoh: Finally, an end to the questions. I was starting to think they'd never end. I'll send data over to the Professor.
it: \bGoh: Finalmente, basta domande. Cominciavo a pensare che non sarebbero mai finite. Manderò i dati al Professore.
